name: @mavis/extension-dispatcher
description: The ONE extension dispatcher (W07 part B, map §4 A5 row «сливаются pi ToolDefinition/exposure/loadout и mcode registry/SPI; два public extension API обслуживаются одним dispatcher»): both public extension APIs — the pi ExtensionAPI compatibility surface and the product plugin-hook command SPI — register and dispatch through this single ordered funnel. No second event hub may be created on top of it.
